source_text.body:
Monitor used-car listings and price changes
A user runs Claude Code scripts from cron to track local used-car listings, how long they stay up, and price changes.
·
Nov 7, 2026
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
The user had Claude write scripts, then ran them from cron to watch used-car listings limited to their local area and price range. The scripts tracked how long listings stayed up and recorded price changes; for now, Claude only analyzes that collected data and points out what looks interesting, with the user planning to turn on alerts later when ready to buy.
How it went
It already gives the user analysis on listing patterns, and the intended next step is alerts for specific cars so they can jump on a deal. The post does not report a purchase, savings, or any performance numbers yet.
Worth knowing
The main catch is that this is not fully automated end-to-end yet: the user says it currently analyzes the data only, and alerts are planned for later.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Write a script that checks used-car listings on [site] for [make/model, price range, zip code and radius] and saves results to [CSV or SQLite file]. Record each listing's first-seen date, price changes, and when it disappears. Then set it to run daily via cron, and show me the cron line before installing it. You're done when I can run a command that prints new listings, price drops, and how long listings stay up.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1xk7ktb/do_you_use_code_for_not_coding_too
